\[
Q_c = P(\tan\varphi_1 - \tan\varphi_2)
\]

已知：

- \(\cos\varphi_1 = 0.8\)，则 \(\tan\varphi_1 = 0.75\)
- \(\cos\varphi_2 = 0.9\)，则 \(\tan\varphi_2 \approx 0.484\)
- \(P = 750\text{kW}\)

因此：

\[
Q_c = 750 \times (0.75 - 0.484) \approx 750 \times 0.266 \approx 199.5\text{kvar}
\]
